description: One state list for the northbound record (C1) and the durable record (C6): session model §10's live, detached, killed and terminated, with immortality §7's unreachable beside them. orphan-pending is the worker's state while the core is gone: no core can persist it and no message carries it, and its outcome lands as killed / orphan through the spool. There is no disconnected state and no grace (decision 5.45), and no expiry: a timer's end is killed.
